steps.text: ♪ Do you hear the thunderclap? ♪
♪ See the clouds blanket the peaks ♪
♪ Long forgotten faces, long forgotten things ♪
♪ Find the way back to Vermeil ♪
♪ Take me home ♪
♪ Bright red clouds ♪
10:37 A.M. \ Overcast
Siracusa Low Catastrophe Sector - Wilderness - Cabin in the Woods
I heard you singing. There is no need to hide. I bear you no ill will.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...The headsmen all say that. But in the end, they draw blood.
Headsman? I am afraid I do not understand your wording. I represent the Laterano Notarial Hall——

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Shut up! You can't fool me!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I gotcha!
You did not.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Eeh?!
Pardon.
Target escaped out the window. Quick response time.
Environment analyzed. Cured fowl meat, tanning bench, processed animal skins, worked with wooden tools and small knives.
Drop the bow. I am aware of your position, hiding behind the window.
I repeat, I bear you no ill will.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ——No way!
Your awareness of your surroundings is impressive.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'll turn you into a pincushion!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: H- he caught it with his hand?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: But... what the hell are you?!
As the report states, the heir is fickle, slow to trust, and difficult to communicate with.
The above is my last will and testament in its entirety.
However, I have one final, selfish request.
In the forests of Siracusa, I met a one-armed Vulpo girl.
She had long walked a single-minded path of revenge.
In my compassion, I gave her aid. While this may have hurt her pride, I found myself moved by her stubborn determination to survive.
I later learned that the aid I gave her only strengthened her obsession with revenge, which left me uneasy.
I want to give her all that I have. Sadly, that is very little. Only a few sad heirlooms.
——Pardon the interruption, but there is no Vulpo on your list of kin. This will make our work rather difficult.
As such, this is but a petty request from a childless Laterano citizen on his deathbed.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: (I smell blood on him. And he gives me a nasty feeling...)

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: (Another fella coming to wreck up our homestead? Gross!)

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: He took the bait!
I see. Another trap. There are trigger mechanisms all over.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Listen up! You walked right into a hunter's trap. If you don't wanna die, hand over your weapons and don't move!
If that will aid communication, I will comply.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Who are you?
I am an executor from the Laterano Notarial Hall, working as executor of this estate. You may call me 'Executor.'

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Laterano...?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: 'Vermeil,' you are the target of my mission.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: How do you know my name?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Your name was given by the deceased, Mr Dürrenmatt.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I don't know any Dürrenmatt.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: For several reasons, he used a variety of aliases.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Where do you wanna take me?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: In the interests of secrecy, I cannot say.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...Grr, you're full of it! You're gonna die here!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I'm not leaving. My mom, my dad, my uncle, my auntie, my friends, my people, they're all, all...

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: My task is to bring only you.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Shut up! Do you even know where you are?!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I am in a situation in which I am unable to advance my mission.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hrmph. Anything that walks into this forest is our prey.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: The bones you're standing on are all beasts and even worse people.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I understand. The area around this base of operations was full of traps.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Pits, snares, landmines, triggered darts.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Rest assured, I have disarmed them all. The traps were of basic construction, but carried the possibility of injuring the object.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Please, come with me.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ——! Stay back!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: One step closer and I'll shoot you dead!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: She escaped again.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hey, why did you save me?

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: I'm a hunter too, after all.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: How could I look past a respected colleague, short one arm and lying in a pile of her own guts next to a big old tusker?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hmph... You're no hunter. You can't fool me. I don't smell any dirt on you at all.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: Hah. I guess I can't. But when I saw you there, I was moved by how well a little one like you had conquered the wilderness. That's the truth.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: Just saying what comes to mind.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: What's the deal with the circle on your head? And the thingies on your back?

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: Have you never seen a Laterano before, Little One?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: These are... I guess they're what's left of my homeland I walked away from.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: You can't ever clean off the dirt from your hometown.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: Maybe you're right. The short of it is, a lot's happened. Come, let's try to get you walking.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: Let me put this on you.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: This... it's an arm? A metal arm? What a weird thing.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: A token of my respect for a child of the wilderness.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: You a carpenter? A metalworker?

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: I learned all sorts of things in my old job.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...You saved me, so you can't be bad. I'm gonna need an arm to get my revenge. So thank you.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: Revenge, huh...? Well, I can't decide your fate for you.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: But when you pull your bowstring with this arm, I hope you'll think about why it is we're alive, besides revenge.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: If you don't think enough, you might just end up like me.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: I don't want to hear you say 'I live for revenge.' That's too cliche.

steps.name: Old Huntsman
steps.text: ...Damn right. Totally played out.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: (Laterano... He said he's from Laterano...)

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: (It couldn't be...)

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Ack! That hurts!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: It seems Mr Dürrenmatt's assessment was correct.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Damn it, how long have you been hunting me?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hey! Let me go!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Stop resisting. I cannot hurt you, as you are the heir to this will.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: This is a letter from the deceased.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Why do you continue to resist?

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...That's his scent. The letter has the scent of his blood. What did you do to him?!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The journey from Laterano to this place was extremely long. It is not possible that any scent of the deceased remains.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Answer me! Or I'll kill you!

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: First, I believe demonstrating the power differential at hand may aid in communication.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Second, out of respect for you as the heir, I will answer your question.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Mr Dürrenmatt died on the operating table. It was not a peaceful passing. He suffered from an incurable disease.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: You——! Let go!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Such was his choice.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hey! Wh- what are you doing?!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Originium crystals have already pierced the skin. The infection continues to worsen.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: None of your business!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: If the object insists on rejecting her benefit, according to regulations, I am permitted to abandon the task.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: But the client and my superiors issued a subordinating clause. I must execute it.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ——What the hell are you trying to do?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: 'Let Vermeil live.'

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: As this is a rather broad request, executing it will be quite complicated. It is my hope that you cooperate.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...That's what he asked you to do?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Correct. He sold all of his property, paid a number of additional fees, including those of the Notarial Hall, as well as the costs of your future medical treatment.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: But, why? I'm just some girl from the forest...

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: He wants you to live.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: And I'm asking why!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Because he believed you deserve to live.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Now that the last will and testament has been executed, my work here is done.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Wh...! When did you slip this to me——?!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Before we proceed to the next phase, I must hear your reply.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: 'Do you want to live?'

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: You need only answer: 'Yes,' or 'no.'

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Our time is limited.
Hey, Mister, what am I supposed to call you?
——Executor. If you must call me something.
Thank you for accepting my request.
——It was the Notarial Hall's decision. I am merely executing my duties.
Hah, sure enough. And while you're looking for Vermeil, I have another little request.
——Depending on the nature of the request, I may reject your verbal appeal. I would prefer you submit it in written form to the Notarial Hall.
You're a real hardass, huh? Doesn't matter. It's just a little thing.
Don't tell her anything about my past, if you can. Make up some story. Tell her I died on the operating table.
——I do not understand the need for this request. Nor does it fit with the truth. You fled the Notarial Hall's justice for many years, and you shot dead...
Enough. What if I told you doing it this way would save you a lot of trouble in getting your job done?
——If in my judgment I agree with your assessment, I will consider your request.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: ...So this Rhodes Island place, they can really cure this crazy disease?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Medical science has yet to cure Oripathy. But they may be able to alleviate your suffering.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Considering what you did to the Ursus, I advise against continuing to act alone.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: And it just happens that I must go to Rhodes Island on another matter.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Are you asking me to go with you?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I believe that would be most logical.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hmph. I refuse.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I still have a lot to do before I can leave here. I have to say goodbye to my people.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: It is dangerous here. Hatred does not end in compromise.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hmph... You sure know a lot.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I don't care what you know. Don't get in my way. I can still go to this Rhodes Island place even after I settle everything, can't I?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Allow me to calculate.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I must calculate if I have enough ammunition to deal with those fugitives when they find you again.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Ammunition...? You mean you would go out into the barrens with me?!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: In accordance with your answer, you have been marked by the Notarial Hall as having accepted your inheritance.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: However, the contents of the will have not been fully executed. I cannot allow you to expose yourself to such danger. This is my duty.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: I don't need your help! I'm used to being on my own——

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Furthermore, I believe you seek to compromise with me, and then seize the opportunity to escape.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: There is no time to waste. Let us depart.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Hey! I didn't say yes! I don't need some outlander to come and... Hey, wait! Where are you going? Do you even know the way?!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Watch your feet, there's——

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I have disarmed the traps. Come with me.

steps.name: Vermeil
steps.text: Aaah——Sooner or later, I'll show you, you weirdo——!
Please take good care of her, Mr Executor. Really, it could be good for you too.
Don't give me that look. You know what I mean.
Get her out of that mud hole. Don't let her end up like me.
Justice? Maybe what I did was justified, Mister, if the Notarial Hall could find it in their hearts to forgive me.
But it still wouldn't be anything to cheer about. Honestly, it just makes life seem like a big joke.
Her. She's my legacy though.
My hopes and dreams.
May the Lord bless her and keep her.
